<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1900" height="3000" viewBox="0 0 1900 3000" role="img" aria-labelledby="chr3_g3_title chr3_g3_desc" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC, Microsoft JhengHei, Droid Sans Fallback, sans-serif" fill="#24343f">
<title id="chr3_g3_title">層析概論｜全章方法分類與大小循環對照</title><desc id="chr3_g3_desc">層析概論教學向量圖，v3.0。四站角色固定：先定問題、準備與測量、讀訊號、核對結論。灰線表示分析資訊；圖4藍線為液體流路、綠線為樣品／離子路徑。座標曲線依各子圖標示。紅虛線表示條件不符的分析者回查。示意不按比例。</desc>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1900" height="3000" rx="0" fill="#f8f6ee" stroke="#f8f6ee" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="50" y="64" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">PHARMACEUTICAL ANALYSIS / CH18 / CHROMATOGRAPHY / v3.0</text>
<text x="50" y="120" font-size="38" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">層析概論｜全章方法分類與大小循環對照</text>
<text x="50" y="164" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">同一方法可同時有物態、形式、機制與模式；分類用群組，測量流程才用箭頭。</text>
<rect x="50" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="71" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M01｜先定問題</text>
<text x="71" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">目的與檢品</text>
<polyline points="470,262 506,262" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="506.0,262.0 494.6,268.2 494.6,255.8" fill="#61717a"/>
<rect x="510" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="531" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M02｜準備與測量</text>
<text x="531" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">製樣、作用與條件</text>
<polyline points="930,262 966,262" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="966.0,262.0 954.6,268.2 954.6,255.8" fill="#61717a"/>
<rect x="970" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="991" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M03｜讀訊號</text>
<text x="991" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">量、單位與處理</text>
<polyline points="1390,262 1426,262" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="1426.0,262.0 1414.6,268.2 1414.6,255.8" fill="#61717a"/>
<rect x="1430" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1451" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M04｜核對結論</text>
<text x="1451" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">判讀、限制與品質</text>
<rect x="50" y="370" width="576" height="375" rx="18" fill="#fff1c8" stroke="#9e771c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="412" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#9e771c">動相物態</text>
<text x="72" y="464.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">LC液體；GC氣體；SFC超臨界流體。</text>
<text x="72" y="497" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">固定相可為固體，或由載體保持的液體。</text>
<text x="72" y="529.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">相關L01；Q30修正「動相均液體」。</text>
<rect x="662" y="370" width="576" height="375" rx="18" fill="#fff1c8" stroke="#9e771c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="684" y="412" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#9e771c">裝置形式</text>
<text x="684" y="464.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">管柱：HPLC、GC等。</text>
<text x="684" y="497" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">平面：TLC、紙層析。</text>
<text x="684" y="529.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">時間峰與斑點遷移是不同讀數。</text>
<rect x="1274" y="370" width="576" height="375" rx="18" fill="#fff1c8" stroke="#9e771c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1296" y="412" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#9e771c">主要作用機制</text>
<text x="1296" y="464.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">吸附：表面作用。</text>
<text x="1296" y="497" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">分配：兩相濃度比。</text>
<text x="1296" y="529.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">離子交換：交換／帶電作用。</text>
<text x="1296" y="562.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">SEC尺寸排斥：可進入孔隙不同。</text>
<rect x="50" y="800" width="880" height="225" rx="18" fill="#d9eeea" stroke="#286c68" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="842" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#286c68">正相／逆相｜是模式差異</text>
<text x="72" y="894.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">正相常用極性固定相；逆相常用疏水固定相，如C18／ODS（Octadecylsilyl）。</text>
<text x="72" y="927" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">不能無條件背「較極性一定晚」；需查游離狀態與其他作用。</text>
<rect x="970" y="800" width="880" height="225" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="842" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">分析目的｜決定M03要讀什麼</text>
<text x="992" y="894.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">保留看tR與基準；兩峰分離看Rs；柱品質看H或N/L。</text>
<text x="992" y="927" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">定量看有效校正；身分確認看參考與互補證據。</text>
<rect x="50" y="1085" width="420" height="120" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="1127" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">P1｜M01對象與目的</text>
<text x="72" y="1179.34" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">本方法的差異放在這一站</text>
<rect x="510" y="1085" width="420" height="120" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="532" y="1127" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">P2｜M02原理與條件</text>
<text x="532" y="1179.34" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">本方法的差異放在這一站</text>
<rect x="970" y="1085" width="420" height="120" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="1127" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">P3｜M03裝置與讀數</text>
<text x="992" y="1179.34" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">本方法的差異放在這一站</text>
<rect x="1430" y="1085" width="420" height="120" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1452" y="1127" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">P4｜M04判定與限制</text>
<text x="1452" y="1179.34" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">本方法的差異放在這一站</text>
<rect x="50" y="1235" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="1277" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">HPLC｜目的</text>
<text x="72" y="1329.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">High-performance liquid</text>
<text x="72" y="1362" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">chromatography</text>
<text x="72" y="1394.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">相容溶液進樣，分離藥物／不純物；</text>
<text x="72" y="1427.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">如 Acetaminophen 的不純物或</text>
<text x="72" y="1459.98" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Ketoprofen。定量還需選擇性與校</text>
<text x="72" y="1492.64" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">正。</text>
<rect x="510" y="1235" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="532" y="1277" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">HPLC｜作用</text>
<text x="532" y="1329.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">液體動相經柱分離；可採不同固定相</text>
<text x="532" y="1362" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">／機制。等度示例用 t₀、k′、α、</text>
<text x="532" y="1394.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Rs、N、H；相組成、溫度、流量須</text>
<text x="532" y="1427.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">受控。</text>
<rect x="970" y="1235" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="1277" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">HPLC｜讀出</text>
<text x="992" y="1329.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">溶劑供應、泵、進樣器、管柱、相容</text>
<text x="992" y="1362" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">偵測器與資料系統；tR、W用min，</text>
<text x="992" y="1394.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">流量F用mL/min，面積用儀器面積單</text>
<text x="992" y="1427.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">位。</text>
<rect x="1430" y="1235" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1452" y="1277" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">HPLC｜證據</text>
<text x="1452" y="1329.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">按參考、校正及系統適用性判讀；共</text>
<text x="1452" y="1362" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">流出、管外展寬、過載、樣品溶劑及</text>
<text x="1452" y="1394.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">柱狀態可影響結果。tR相同不單獨證</text>
<text x="1452" y="1427.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">明身分。</text>
<rect x="50" y="1670" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="1712" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">GC｜目的</text>
<text x="72" y="1764.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Gas chromatography</text>
<text x="72" y="1797" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">適合可揮發且熱穩定，或經相容衍生</text>
<text x="72" y="1829.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">化的成分；可用於適合的摻偽分析。</text>
<text x="72" y="1862.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">不是每種藥物都能直接進樣。</text>
<rect x="510" y="1670" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="532" y="1712" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">GC｜作用</text>
<text x="532" y="1764.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">氣體動相帶分析物經固定相；保留與</text>
<text x="532" y="1797" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">展寬也受溫度、載氣與柱配置影響。</text>
<text x="532" y="1829.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">本章定流量LC的體積式不能不修正就</text>
<text x="532" y="1862.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">搬到可壓縮氣體。</text>
<rect x="970" y="1670" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="1712" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">GC｜讀出</text>
<text x="992" y="1764.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">載氣、進樣口、柱／烘箱、相容偵測</text>
<text x="992" y="1797" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">器與資料系統；tR、W為時間，面積</text>
<text x="992" y="1829.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">需指定偵測與處理。</text>
<rect x="1430" y="1670" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1452" y="1712" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">GC｜證據</text>
<text x="1452" y="1764.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">與適當標準及偵測證據比對；熱分</text>
<text x="1452" y="1797" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">解、進樣歧視、共流出可干擾。原題</text>
<text x="1452" y="1829.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">列GC可作確認方法，並未證明所有檢</text>
<text x="1452" y="1862.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">品均適用。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2105" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="2147" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">TLC｜目的</text>
<text x="72" y="2199.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Thin-layer chromatography</text>
<text x="72" y="2232" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">相容檢品點樣，供分離／比對斑點、</text>
<text x="72" y="2264.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">摻偽或身分線索；定量另需適當掃描</text>
<text x="72" y="2297.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">與校正。</text>
<rect x="510" y="2105" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="532" y="2147" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">TLC｜作用</text>
<text x="532" y="2199.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">薄層固定相與展開溶劑形成差異遷</text>
<text x="532" y="2232" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">移；點樣、展開與前緣標記一致。斑</text>
<text x="532" y="2264.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">點位置不是管柱保留時間。</text>
<rect x="970" y="2105" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="2147" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">TLC｜讀出</text>
<text x="992" y="2199.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">薄層板、點樣器、展開槽、展開溶劑</text>
<text x="992" y="2232" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">及適當顯色／觀察。Rf=斑點中心走</text>
<text x="992" y="2264.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">的距離÷溶劑前緣距離，兩距離從同</text>
<text x="992" y="2297.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">一起點量，無單位。</text>
<rect x="1430" y="2105" width="420" height="390" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1452" y="2147" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">TLC｜證據</text>
<text x="1452" y="2199.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">與同條件標準並行比較位置與顯色；</text>
<text x="1452" y="2232" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">共遷移、點樣過大、槽條件不一致影</text>
<text x="1452" y="2264.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">響結論。單一相同Rf仍不足以唯一確</text>
<text x="1452" y="2297.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">認未知物。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2590" width="880" height="255" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="2632" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">LC-ESI-MS｜配置，不另列成一種固定相</text>
<text x="72" y="2684.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M01分離並辨識 → M02以LC分離、ESI電灑游離 → M03以MS讀m/z與離子豐度 →</text>
<text x="72" y="2717" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M04核對參考。</text>
<text x="72" y="2749.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Q41：0.21 cm=2.1 mm；是題本配對，不是ESI普遍尺寸上限。</text>
<rect x="970" y="2590" width="880" height="255" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="2632" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">其他辨識位置與反例</text>
<text x="992" y="2684.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">紙層析、SFC：概論分類補充，不冒稱53題另有完整操作題。</text>
<text x="992" y="2717" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">AES原子放射看元素；Q26不把元素當特定有機西藥的唯一分子確認。</text>
<text x="992" y="2749.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">TLC補充：Rf=斑點中心距離／前緣距離，同起點、無單位。</text>
<text x="50" y="2932" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">核心方法HPLC、GC、TLC各走P1–P4；ESI是游離介面、MS是離子讀出。補充分類來源：IUPAC、USP公開導論。</text>
<text x="50" y="2968" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">原題：CH18 PDF；正文：建構講義 v3.0。M＝大循環站；L＝理解模組；P＝方法條目。示意不按比例。</text>
</svg>

</details>

<details>
<summary>展開圖4｜儀器與操作考點圖</summary>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1900" height="3090" viewBox="0 0 1900 3090" role="img" aria-labelledby="chr3_g4_title chr3_g4_desc" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC, Microsoft JhengHei, Droid Sans Fallback, sans-serif" fill="#24343f">
<title id="chr3_g4_title">層析概論｜儀器、流路與操作考點</title><desc id="chr3_g4_desc">層析概論教學向量圖，v3.0。四站角色固定：先定問題、準備與測量、讀訊號、核對結論。灰線表示分析資訊；圖4藍線為液體流路、綠線為樣品／離子路徑。座標曲線依各子圖標示。紅虛線表示條件不符的分析者回查。示意不按比例。</desc>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1900" height="3090" rx="0" fill="#f8f6ee" stroke="#f8f6ee" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="50" y="64" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">PHARMACEUTICAL ANALYSIS / CH18 / CHROMATOGRAPHY / v3.0</text>
<text x="50" y="120" font-size="38" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">層析概論｜儀器、流路與操作考點</text>
<text x="50" y="164" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">HPLC示意：實際液體流路與資料訊號分開；UV與ESI-MS畫成替代配置。</text>
<rect x="50" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="71" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M01｜先定問題</text>
<text x="71" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">目的與檢品</text>
<polyline points="470,262 506,262" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="506.0,262.0 494.6,268.2 494.6,255.8" fill="#61717a"/>
<rect x="510" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="531" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M02｜準備與測量</text>
<text x="531" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">製樣、作用與條件</text>
<polyline points="930,262 966,262" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="966.0,262.0 954.6,268.2 954.6,255.8" fill="#61717a"/>
<rect x="970" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="991" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M03｜讀訊號</text>
<text x="991" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">量、單位與處理</text>
<polyline points="1390,262 1426,262" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="1426.0,262.0 1414.6,268.2 1414.6,255.8" fill="#61717a"/>
<rect x="1430" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1451" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M04｜核對結論</text>
<text x="1451" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">判讀、限制與品質</text>
<rect x="50" y="380" width="420" height="260" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="422" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">溶劑供應</text>
<text x="72" y="474.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">相組成／pH；按方法準備。</text>
<text x="72" y="507" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">代表性檢品與動相相容。</text>
<polyline points="470,510 506,510" fill="none" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="506.0,510.0 494.6,516.2 494.6,503.8" fill="#326991"/>
<rect x="510" y="380" width="420" height="260" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="532" y="422" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">泵</text>
<text x="532" y="474.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">設定體積流量F。</text>
<text x="532" y="507" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">F：mL/min；不是u：cm/s。</text>
<polyline points="930,510 966,510" fill="none" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="966.0,510.0 954.6,516.2 954.6,503.8" fill="#326991"/>
<rect x="970" y="380" width="420" height="260" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="422" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">進樣器</text>
<text x="992" y="474.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">受控進樣塞；避免過載。</text>
<text x="992" y="507" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">進樣量不在基本Van Deemter中，仍</text>
<text x="992" y="539.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">可影響實際峰。</text>
<polyline points="1390,510 1426,510" fill="none" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="1426.0,510.0 1414.6,516.2 1414.6,503.8" fill="#326991"/>
<rect x="1430" y="380" width="420" height="260" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1452" y="422" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">管柱／控溫</text>
<text x="1452" y="474.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">固定相、L、dp、df與溫度。</text>
<text x="1452" y="507" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L01分離；L12–14展寬。</text>
<rect x="900" y="690" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#dcecdc" stroke="#356844" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="922" y="732" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#356844">樣品 → 進樣器</text>
<text x="922" y="784.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">製樣與溶劑、量和體積須相容</text>
<polyline points="1110,690 1110,640" fill="none" stroke="#356844" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="1110.0,640.0 1116.2,651.4 1103.8,651.4" fill="#356844"/>
<text x="1425" y="724" font-size="23" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">以下為兩種替代偵測配置</text>
<rect x="650" y="850" width="550" height="190" rx="18" fill="#fff1c8" stroke="#9e771c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="672" y="892" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#9e771c">UV偵測池｜光學配置</text>
<text x="672" y="944.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">流出物通過偵測池，形成訊號。</text>
<text x="672" y="977" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">光源／池為本配置部件，不是每種偵測器都有。</text>
<polyline points="1640,640 1640,825 925,825 925,850" fill="none" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="925.0,850.0 918.8,838.6 931.2,838.6" fill="#326991"/>
<rect x="65" y="855" width="430" height="185" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="87" y="897" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">UV池後｜廢液</text>
<text x="87" y="949.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">液體繼續流出；廢液不是分析結論。</text>
<polyline points="650,940 495,940" fill="none" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="495.0,940.0 506.4,933.8 506.4,946.2" fill="#326991"/>
<rect x="1410" y="850" width="440" height="185" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1432" y="892" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">ESI｜電灑游離</text>
<text x="1432" y="944.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">流出物經相容介面游離成離子。</text>
<text x="1432" y="977" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">2.1 mm題本配對需查流量與溶劑。</text>
<polyline points="1640,825 1640,850" fill="none" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="1640.0,850.0 1633.8,838.6 1646.2,838.6" fill="#326991"/>
<rect x="1410" y="1105" width="440" height="155" rx="18" fill="#dcecdc" stroke="#356844" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1432" y="1147" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#356844">MS｜離子分析</text>
<text x="1432" y="1199.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">讀m/z與離子豐度，不是光的波長。</text>
<polyline points="1630,1035 1630,1105" fill="none" stroke="#356844" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="1630.0,1105.0 1623.8,1093.6 1636.2,1093.6" fill="#356844"/>
<rect x="650" y="1120" width="550" height="150" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="672" y="1162" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">M03｜資料與峰處理</text>
<text x="672" y="1214.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">時間、積分面積、峰寬與峰形。</text>
<text x="672" y="1247" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L02、07–09、15：先確認量法。</text>
<polyline points="925,1040 925,1120" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

<polygon points="1200.0,1180.0 1211.4,1173.8 1211.4,1186.2" fill="#61717a"/>
<text x="50" y="1334" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">圖例：藍＝液體；綠＝樣品／離子；灰＝資料。兩配置並排為選擇示意，非同時分流。</text>
<text x="50" y="1368" font-size="21" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">HPLC＝高效液相層析；UV＝紫外吸收偵測；ESI＝電灑游離；MS＝質譜。</text>

<polyline points="360,1768 360,1848" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="10 7"/>
<text x="295" y="1743" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">t₀=1</text>
<polyline points="360,1848 360,1860" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="350" y="1889" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">1</text>
<polyline points="700,1588 700,1848" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="10 7"/>
<text x="635" y="1563" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">A：tR=3</text>
<polyline points="700,1848 700,1860" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="690" y="1889" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">3</text>
<polyline points="1380,1588 1380,1848" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="10 7"/>
<text x="1315" y="1563" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">B：tR=7</text>
<polyline points="1380,1848 1380,1860" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="1370" y="1889" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">7</text>
<polyline points="530,1848 615.0,1690.3020284747154" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polyline points="785.0,1690.3020284747154 870,1848" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polyline points="530,1912 870,1912" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polyline points="530,1904 530,1921" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polyline points="870,1904 870,1921" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="555.5" y="1950" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">基線切線寬W</text>
<text x="880" y="1700" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#326991">陰影是峰面積</text>
<text x="880" y="1740" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#326991">需接校正才能談濃度</text>
<text x="75" y="1990" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">tR看位置；W看展寬；面積看校正後的量。半高寬、5%寬與10%寬另量，不能自行互換。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2070" width="880" height="237" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="2112" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">面積大就說不同藥濃度高</text>
<text x="72" y="2164.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L02：查各自校正與響應因子。</text>
<text x="72" y="2197" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">回M03量／校正，再交M04。</text>
<rect x="970" y="2070" width="880" height="237" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="2112" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">改F只看時間</text>
<text x="992" y="2164.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L11、13：時間反比先成立；效率另看u與H。</text>
<text x="992" y="2197" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">回M02核條件，再測與判。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2347" width="880" height="237" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="2389" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">把進樣量當永不展寬</text>
<text x="72" y="2441.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L12：基本式柱內模型≠過載／寬進樣塞。</text>
<text x="72" y="2474" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">回M02查進樣、連接管及池體積。</text>
<rect x="970" y="2347" width="880" height="237" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="2389" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">小內徑一定更有效率</text>
<text x="992" y="2441.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L09、16：查粒徑、填充、u與管外展寬。</text>
<text x="992" y="2474" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">回M02核配置；不由柱徑單獨推H。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2624" width="880" height="237" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="2666" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">W量錯卻只重選公式</text>
<text x="72" y="2718.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L07–08：先確認基線切線／半高全寬。</text>
<text x="72" y="2751" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">回M03重讀同定義，再計Rs與N。</text>
<rect x="970" y="2624" width="880" height="237" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="2666" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">拖尾便唯一判入口空隙</text>
<text x="992" y="2718.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L15：列樣品、進樣、表面與柱狀態候選。</text>
<text x="992" y="2751" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">回M02取得可區分原因的資料。</text>
<text x="50" y="3022" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">操作修正後要重新取得必要資料；診斷箭頭是分析者回查，不是由峰形唯一倒推出原因。硬體細節依配置。</text>
<text x="50" y="3058" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">原題：CH18 PDF；正文：建構講義 v3.0。M＝大循環站；L＝理解模組；P＝方法條目。示意不按比例。</text>

<details>
<summary>展開圖5｜公式與誤差判讀總表</summary>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1900" height="3130" viewBox="0 0 1900 3130" role="img" aria-labelledby="chr3_g5_title chr3_g5_desc" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC, Microsoft JhengHei, Droid Sans Fallback, sans-serif" fill="#24343f">
<title id="chr3_g5_title">層析概論｜公式與誤差判讀總表</title><desc id="chr3_g5_desc">層析概論教學向量圖，v3.0。四站角色固定：先定問題、準備與測量、讀訊號、核對結論。灰線表示分析資訊；圖4藍線為液體流路、綠線為樣品／離子路徑。座標曲線依各子圖標示。紅虛線表示條件不符的分析者回查。示意不按比例。</desc>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1900" height="3130" rx="0" fill="#f8f6ee" stroke="#f8f6ee" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="50" y="64" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">PHARMACEUTICAL ANALYSIS / CH18 / CHROMATOGRAPHY / v3.0</text>
<text x="50" y="120" font-size="38" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">層析概論｜公式與誤差判讀總表</text>
<text x="50" y="164" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">問哪個量 → 確認定義與前提 → 整理再算 → 核對單位、方向及證據。</text>
<rect x="50" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="71" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M01｜先定問題</text>
<text x="71" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">目的與檢品</text>
<polyline points="470,262 506,262" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="506.0,262.0 494.6,268.2 494.6,255.8" fill="#61717a"/>
<rect x="510" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="531" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M02｜準備與測量</text>
<text x="531" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">製樣、作用與條件</text>
<polyline points="930,262 966,262" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="966.0,262.0 954.6,268.2 954.6,255.8" fill="#61717a"/>
<rect x="970" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="991" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M03｜讀訊號</text>
<text x="991" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">量、單位與處理</text>
<polyline points="1390,262 1426,262" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="1426.0,262.0 1414.6,268.2 1414.6,255.8" fill="#61717a"/>
<rect x="1430" y="205" width="420" height="115" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1451" y="246" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">M04｜核對結論</text>
<text x="1451" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">判讀、限制與品質</text>
<rect x="50" y="370" width="880" height="330" rx="18" fill="#d9eeea" stroke="#286c68" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="412" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#286c68">時間／相對保留｜L03–04</text>
<text x="72" y="464.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M02供V₀、F → M03得t₀=V₀/F。</text>
<text x="72" y="497" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">k′=(tR−t₀)/t₀=(VR−V₀)/V₀。</text>
<text x="72" y="529.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">tR=t₀(1+k′)，別漏共同時間。</text>
<text x="72" y="562.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">F用mL/min、t用min；k′無量綱。</text>
<text x="72" y="594.98" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">V₀不是空管幾何體積。</text>
<rect x="970" y="370" width="880" height="330" rx="18" fill="#d9eeea" stroke="#286c68" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="412" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#286c68">K與α｜L05–06</text>
<text x="992" y="464.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M02供K、VS、VM → k′=KVS/VM。</text>
<text x="992" y="497" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">VR=VM+KVS：線性、K不隨濃度變。</text>
<text x="992" y="529.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M03供共同基準與兩峰 → α=k₂′/k₁′。</text>
<text x="992" y="562.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">先出k₁′&gt;0；後出放分子。</text>
<text x="992" y="594.98" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">K、k′、α不同；cS≠質傳CS。</text>
<rect x="50" y="745" width="880" height="330" rx="18" fill="#dcecdc" stroke="#356844" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="787" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#356844">兩峰解析度｜L07</text>
<text x="72" y="839.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M03供峰距與同種寬度 → M04判Rs。</text>
<text x="72" y="872" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">基線切線寬：Rs=2ΔtR/(W₁+W₂)。</text>
<text x="72" y="904.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">半高全寬：Rs=1.18ΔtR/(W½₁+W½₂)。</text>
<text x="72" y="937.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">近高斯換算；兩峰時間差、寬度和。</text>
<text x="72" y="969.98" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Rs無量綱；相同峰頂Rs=0。</text>
<rect x="970" y="745" width="880" height="330" rx="18" fill="#dcecdc" stroke="#356844" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="787" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#356844">單峰板數與柱品質｜L08–09</text>
<text x="992" y="839.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M03供tR、W → N=16(tR/W)²。</text>
<text x="992" y="872" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">半高寬改5.54(tR/W½)²。</text>
<text x="992" y="904.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">N用總tR；plates/m=N/L（L用m）。</text>
<text x="992" y="937.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">H=L/N；同基準比N/L最大或H最小。</text>
<text x="992" y="969.98" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">N總數≠每單位長度品質。</text>
<rect x="50" y="1120" width="880" height="330" rx="18" fill="#e8e1f2" stroke="#685185" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="1162" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#685185">改L／F與三因子｜L10–11</text>
<text x="72" y="1214.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Rs≈√N/4 ×(α−1)/α ×k₂′/(1+k₂′)。</text>
<text x="72" y="1247" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">等度、近高斯、相鄰峰效率近似可比。</text>
<text x="72" y="1279.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">同H、u與保留化學：N∝L、tR∝L；</text>
<text x="72" y="1312.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">時間W∝√L、Rs∝√L；k′與α不變。</text>
<text x="72" y="1344.98" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">同VR改F：tR∝1/F；效率另核u。</text>
<rect x="970" y="1120" width="880" height="330" rx="18" fill="#dceaf7" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="1162" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#326991">展寬與比例｜L12–14</text>
<text x="992" y="1214.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">H=A+B/u+Cu；u是長度／時間。</text>
<text x="992" y="1247" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">A多路徑，B/u縱向擴散，Cu總質傳。</text>
<text x="992" y="1279.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">B,C&gt;0且固定：uopt=√(B/C)。</text>
<text x="992" y="1312.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">薄膜模型CS∝df²/Ds，其他係數固定。</text>
<text x="992" y="1344.98" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Dm對B與移動相質傳有競爭效應。</text>

<polyline points="1374.0,1735 1374.0,2020" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="10 7"/>
<polyline points="1168.0,2005.75 1683.0,2005.75" fill="none" stroke="#685185" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="1720" y="1980" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#685185">5%</text>
<polyline points="1168.0,2056 1374.0,2056" fill="none" stroke="#286c68" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="1174.0" y="2090" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#286c68">f=0.2</text>
<polyline points="1168.0,2117 1683.0,2117" fill="none" stroke="#685185" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="1258.0" y="2147" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#685185">W₀.₀₅=0.5 min</text>
<text x="1490" y="1703" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">T₅=As=0.5/(2×0.2)</text>
<text x="1490" y="1747" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">=1.25 → 拖尾</text>
<text x="1490" y="1790" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">不能由此求AF₁₀</text>
<rect x="50" y="2225" width="880" height="310" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="2267" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">5%與10%｜L15</text>
<text x="72" y="2319.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">T₅=As=W₀.₀₅/(2f)：1對稱、&gt;1拖尾、&lt;1前伸。</text>
<text x="72" y="2352" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">常見AF₁₀=b₁₀/a₁₀，前後側寬在10%量。</text>
<text x="72" y="2384.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">同名或同符號仍先讀定義；不同高度不可互算。</text>
<rect x="970" y="2225" width="880" height="310" rx="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="2267" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#61717a">Dm方向｜L14</text>
<text x="992" y="2319.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">常用簡化模型：B隨Dm增加；CM常隨1/Dm增加。</text>
<text x="992" y="2352" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Dm小可減縱向擴散，又可增加移動相質傳阻力。</text>
<text x="992" y="2384.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">總H須看速度區域，不能只靠LC／GC名字判。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2590" width="880" height="310" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="2632" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">固定配對的來源界線</text>
<text x="72" y="2684.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Q52：0.7出於解析，題幹沒有給孔隙率。</text>
<text x="72" y="2717" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Q41：0.21 cm=2.1 mm是題本配對，不是ESI上限。</text>
<text x="72" y="2749.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">近高斯約Rs=1.5是常用比較，方法要求可不同。</text>
<rect x="970" y="2590" width="880" height="310" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="992" y="2632" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">讀錯／問錯才回查</text>
<text x="992" y="2684.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">W類型或t₀讀錯 → M03重讀重算。</text>
<text x="992" y="2717" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">操作／峰形不合 → M02修正再測。</text>
<text x="992" y="2749.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">TLC補充Rf=斑點中心距離／前緣距離；同起點。</text>
<text x="992" y="2782.32" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">N、Rs、k′不是濃度，面積還需有效校正。</text>
<text x="50" y="2995" font-size="21" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">t₀／V₀＝未保留時間／體積；tR／VR＝保留時間／體積；k′＝保留因子；α＝分離因子；Rs＝解析度；N／H＝理論板數／板高。</text>
<text x="50" y="3062" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">原題數字不改；紙筆先約分、統一單位。圖中曲線為自編模型／峰形示意；常數來源與完整步驟見建構講義。</text>
<text x="50" y="3098" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">原題：CH18 PDF；正文：建構講義 v3.0。M＝大循環站；L＝理解模組；P＝方法條目。示意不按比例。</text>
</svg>

**答案身分：**53題的來源答案均是所附**題本答案**。Q14印刷A、D；Q25題本聲稱一律給分；本次沒有另讀考選部原公布檔，沒有冒標官方答案。Q19題幹主詞缺字，依解析補讀CS並保留原頁裁圖；Q52的0.7是解析額外假定。Q49的「效率」比較基準與若干擴散、管徑敘述另標科學邊界。

**補充查核（2026-10-01）：**與原題文字分開使用，未宣稱檢視現行付費藥典全文。

- [IUPAC：retention factor](https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/R05359)、[separation factor](https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/S05614)：保留因子用調整保留／未保留基準；本章保留題本k′記號。嚴格分離因子按後出峰定義>1；相同正保留作α=1極限說明。
- [IUPAC：chromatography](https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/C01075)、[adsorption](https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/A00157)、[ion exchange](https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/I03168)、[exclusion](https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/E02261)：用於辨別兩相與不同分類軸。
- [USP公開2021版〈621〉導論](https://doi.usp.org/USPNF/USPNF_M99380_01_01.html)：固定相可為固體或承載液體，動相可為氣、液或超臨界流體；通用分類補充，不冒稱53題皆涵蓋。
- [USP 2021年11月公開協調文本](https://www.usp.org/sites/default/files/usp/document/harmonization/gen-chapter/harmonization-november-2021-m99380.pdf)：本次讀到可檢索的5%對稱因子定義；原站完整PDF下載被拒，故不宣稱逐頁核過此全文。5%量法並用題本原頁及下列製造商資料交叉核對。
- [Shimadzu：板數與對稱因子](https://www.shimadzu.com/an/service-support/technical-support/liquid-chromatography/analysis-results/theoretical_plate.html)：近高斯寬度W=4σ、半高全寬約2.355σ及H=L/N，用於係數與讀數條件。
- [Shimadzu：解析度](https://www.shimadzu.com/an/service-support/technical-support/analysis-basics/basic/resol-1.html)：峰距／平均峰寬、近高斯分離比較與三因子模型；1.5不是零重疊的數學保證。
- [Phenomenex：Van Deemter，2025-06-18](https://www.phenomenex.com/resources/knowledge-center/hplc-knowledge-center/van-deemter-equation)：用於三項展寬、速度與模型範圍；Dm競爭效應另按本章明示的簡化比例推論，未冒稱所有現代LC都嚴格符合。
- [Waters：柱內徑與系統展寬，WKB259344](https://support.waters.com/KB_Chem/Columns/WKB259344_How_do_I_choose_the_optimal_inner_diameter_ID_column_for_my_reverse_phase_application)：用於窄柱、MS流量相容性與管外體積的限制，不把2.1 mm寫成唯一規格。

**外部字根／英文筆記：**本次未提供字根檔；[[Acetaminophen]]、[[Ketoprofen]]、[[Octadecylsilyl]]為外部入口，拼法與存在性待使用者筆記庫核對。這些不列成已通過的內部檔案連結。

**實際檢查：**題數與選項集合、答案身分、紙筆數值、L/R/M與Q/F目標、舊標題入口、兩檔內嵌與獨立圖源、SVG XML及五圖實際渲染均核對。未在使用者的Obsidian裝置點擊實測，不宣稱已完成裝置端驗證。
